title: Self-Study Proofbook
summary: Record cited problems, timed attempts, revisions, and mastery evidence in a private offline ledger.
user: Serious self-learners in math or CS who need a credible, private record of what they can actually solve rather than a course-completion badge.
smallest_useful_product: Local Markdown-first proof/problem ledger with source citation, attempt timer, solution revision history, and printable mastery index.
constraints: Do not redistribute textbook or exam content; support local encrypted export; clearly state that records are not accredited credentials.
